name: TidyTray
author: Juliano Dorneles
description: The ultimate unified tray and bar organizer for Omarchy: manage system tray items and bar widgets with 4 display modes, drag-and-drop, and full keyboard navigation.

barWidget.description: Unified system tray and bar widget organizer

schema.label: Display Mode
schema.description: inline: slides out on the bar; dropdown: floating strip beneath the bar; drawer: popout card in grid/list view

schema.label: Open Trigger
schema.description: Reveal drawer on mouse click or pointer hover

schema.label: Indicator Icon
schema.description: Visual indicator glyph for drawer toggle

schema.label: Auto-hide timeout (seconds, 0 = disabled)
schema.description: Seconds before an expanded section automatically collapses when inactive

schema.label: Animation Duration (ms)
schema.description: Transition speed in milliseconds for slide-out animations

schema.label: Smart Deduplication
schema.description: Suppresses redundant tray icons when corresponding bar widgets are loaded (e.g. Dropbox) and filters ghost unclickable items
